cohort: The study included 6122 women aged 40 years or more who attempted a trial of labor at a single university-affiliated tertiary medical center between 2012 and 2022.
finding: A risk score model, employing a cut-off of 7, successfully predicted intrapartum cesarean delivery in women over 40 years old with an area under the curve of 0.86, based on identified independent risk factors.
mod_finding: The developed risk score model can be used by caregivers to offer a more informed consultation to women aged 40 years or more deciding on their mode of delivery.
